title: Despite a rainy cold day,...
text: Despite a rainy cold day, Camelia provided our small family group with an insightful tour of the city. We enjoyed the sights and the history and lore surrounding them made the tour memorable.
author: Jon_P

title: Walking tour of Old Town - Barcelona
text: Had a wonderful walking tour experience with Fabio in Old Town - Barcelona. He was very prompt in his arrival and pickup at our hotel. He is very knowledgeable and aware of the history of Barcelona. He takes his time explaining the history as we walked through areas as if walking back in time. We highly recommend Fabio for your touring needs in Barcelona. Jackie & Randy
author: Randy_G

title: Hidden Gems of Barcelona and Old Town- a must see
text: Loved the Hidden Gems of Barcelona, Old Town Tour. Our guide Antone was very knowledgeable about the history of Old Town and Gothic Area. He took us in the heart of the city all while providing an incredible history lesson. His passion and teaching was truly a gem.
author: Jacqueline_L

title: Great tour!
text: Great walking tour with Antoine.  Very interesting to compare to the first day tour of the Gaudi sites.  Antoine was very knowledgeable about the history - truly a maze through the old town Barcelona neighborhoods!  Highly recommend!
author: X5954SAannm

title: Peter is the best! :)
text: One of the highlisghts in my vacations in northern Spain. It is the first tour you should do in Barcelona as it gives a broad overview of the construction of this ancient city. Our guide, a local girl whose name escapes me, was patient, kind and a great hostess.
author: prudencior713

title: Barcelona old town
text: I never thought this city would be so interesting. I had been to Barcelona before but this was my first time with a guide, and it totally changed my perspective. It was almost 3 hours with Xavi, a local guy expert in history who helped us to understand Barcelona from different points of view. Thanks for everything!
author: manuelK6945HL

title: Great tour
text: The attention received by Pilar, the person in charge of the local agency, was fast and efficient from the first moment. Our guide in Barcelona, Xavi, was a well of wisdom, he answered all our questions and we had a memorable morning.
author: rasanlo23

title: Barcelona experience!
text: In my previous visit I had done a tour in Sagrada Familia (excellent by the way) but this time I wanted to see more of the city. Roberto was our guide and he couldn't have been better. We walked around the gothic quarter, the cathedral area, the ramblas...talking about the historical and social factors of Barcelona, a perfect combination of present and past
author: Gabriel54321

title: Barcelona Vibes
text: This tour gives an overview of what Barcelona was and is, I think it is the best tour I have done in my entire trip to Spain. Our guide was Joan, a lover of history and politics and a great storyteller. We got to know the inner area of the wall and our experience could not have been better.
author: jessicafernandez93
